correctness.rationale: An exact-image/surjection bijection reduces the problem to subgroups H≤G. A two-generator H must lie in pG and is uniquely \(H_j=C_p\oplus C_{p^j}\); the quotient is \(C_p\oplus C_{p^{b-j}}\), so explicit surjection counts give all rank-two fibers. Cyclic subgroups split completely into orders p, p², and p^j for j≥3. Their counts follow from exact quotient structures and the difference of \(\operatorname{Hom}(G/H,C_{p^j})\) and \(\operatorname{Hom}(G/H,C_{p^{j-1}})\). Summation proves the stated parity totals. The independent standalone enumerator verifies all image histograms over 18 finite p,b cases. Finite tests corroborate but do not establish arbitrary p,b.

value.rationale: Image-type distribution is a natural invariant of square-zero endomorphisms of finite abelian groups, describing differential structures on the underlying module. The first nontrivial short-generator type \(C_{p^2}\oplus C_{p^b}\) exhibits noncyclic images absent in the known type \(C_p\oplus C_{p^b}\); all admissible types, multiplicities, sharp exponent cutoffs, and the even/odd exponent distinction are established uniformly in p and b.
